text:
jon: kicking off preflight for the release window — target services: api@3.0.0, runtime@2.7.0, router@1.9.1, console@5.4.0. please ack cross-service deps and rollback criteria.

maria: ack. proposed canary plan: 5% x 10m, then 25% x 10m if metrics ok. rollback triggers: p50 >150ms OR error_rate >1% OR token-gen p95 regression >30%.

lee: console needs the schema migration (safe-read index). i need a 30m gap after canary start before we flip console traffic. will hold migration until canary stable.

deploy-bot: CI passed. artifacts: api-3.0.0-20260321T15, runtime-2.7.0-20260321T15. Release id=1718287650. tagging release metadata now.

ops-green: FYI last runtime patch caused a KV eviction spike during warmup in staging. recommend throttled ramp + ephemeral quarantine for new nodes. prewarm suggestion: --warmup-concurrency=8.

sre-oncall: +1 on cooldown policy. add automatic fallback: if backend tail >300ms for 5m -> shift traffic to runtime@2.6.9. monitor per-route 95th token generation times too.

jon: noted. action items: lee hold schema mig, maria publish canary weight schedule, ops-green create prewarm job, deploy-bot annotate rollback target.

deploy-bot: annotated release with rollback-target=runtime@2.6.9

console-team-bot: console migration scheduled T+40m after canary start. rollout via FF service: flag console_v5_migration=true -> gradual.

maria: adding release notes draft to PR: bulleted risks, rollback plan, required oncall contacts.

sre-oncall: quick monitoring snippet added to runbook:
```
# quick checks
curl -sS http://telemetry.internal/slo | jq '.p50, .p95, .error_rate'
kubectl get pods -l app=runtime -o jsonpath='{.items[*].status.containerStatuses[*].restartCount}'
```

lee: hold applied. will ping here when migration is safe.

jon: starting canary at 5% now.

deploy-bot: canary started id=canary-1718287650-1

deploy-bot: canary metrics (T+8m): api p50 +8ms, api errors 0.2%, runtime p95 +20ms (within guardrail)

maria: bump to 25% after 12m if numbers hold.

deploy-bot: bumped canary to 25%

sre-oncall: noticing a small spike in router tail latency in eu-west, digging in. correlating requests to router v1.9.1.

ops-green: precautionary move: shifting eu-west back to router@1.9.0 to isolate. initiating `k8s rollout undo` in eu-west.

deploy-bot: rollback step executed for router in eu-west (rollback id=rb-1718287650-eu).

jon: pausing global rollout. lee: keep console migration on hold until eu-west stable.

lee: confirmed, still holding. will not apply migration.

maria: updating release notes: "partial router rollback in eu-west; global canary paused; api/runtime remain at 25%"

sre-oncall: will watch for 20m window. if stable we can resume excluding eu-west and reattempt router deploy with extra debug flags. collect traces for any requests that hit router v1.9.1 in eu-west.

jon: agreed. tagging telemetry and traces: tags=release-1718287650, region=eu-west. please attach spans to the incident thread if you see anomalies.

maria: will schedule a quick sync in 30m to decide next steps. thanks all :thumbsup:

ops-green: prewarm job created and queued (job id=pw-1718287650). will run before any further runtime ramp.

deploy-bot: canary paused at 25% pending eu-west stability.

sre-oncall: capturing logs and traces now. will post a short follow-up with top offenders.

jon: good work. follow-up note: if we need to abort, full rollback plan is in the PR (runtime -> 2.6.9, api rollback plan attached).

maria: copying that to release notes and tagging stakeholders.

(landmark) end of thread for now — will reconvene when eu-west is green.
